title: 第10章 善良的名字
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

和铃心情大好，语气真诚道：“前辈，我一定会救您出去的！”

舔狗系统：“……”她可真能吹。

和铃要是敢把阴阳宗的大魔头放出去，南华宗恐怕要清理门户了。

对于和铃的承诺，男人眼里没有什么波澜。

他甚至连和铃的身份都不曾试探过。

仿佛她说什么，他也就信了什么。

殷神凝只是觉得，这个闯入炁字轮的少女有些不一般。

南华宗的宗主已经换了三任，在此期间，他从未见过任何其他的人。

不过殷神凝无惧寂寞，也不想留她下来说话解闷。

殷神凝笃定，少女会再次回到炁字轮来。

他目光流连在少女的脸上，问道：“你叫什么名字？”

和铃面不改色：“薛妙善。”

听起来非常善良的一个名字。

舔狗系统没想到和铃准备做得这么充足，连假名都提前想好了，一秒都不带犹豫的。

【和铃，这是你穿越之前的名字吗？】它打探道。

【哼。】和铃心中冷哼，【你骂人真难听。】

她的名字就叫和铃，无论是穿越前还是穿越后，都没有分别。

薛妙善可是阴阳宗的魔教妖女，比她心狠手辣多了，对自己人都下得去手，舔狗系统居然说她是薛妙善，她哪里比得上薛妙善？

舔狗系统悟了。

这个薛妙善应该是宿主的敌人。

把锅甩给自己的仇敌，很符合宿主的人设和素质。

和铃爬出无明井，拍了拍自己的衣服，忽然冷不丁听到一声幽暗的声音。

“师妹，这么晚了，你不在房间睡觉，去井底做什么？”

第五齐！

他怎么在这儿？

一时间，和铃脑海里面都冒出了杀人灭口的想法，但很快清醒。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

He Ling was in a good mood and said in a sincere tone: "Senior, I will definitely rescue you!"

Dog-licking system: "..." She can really brag.

If He Ling dares to release the big devil of Yin Yang Sect, Nanhua Sect may have to clean up its doors.

Regarding the promise to Ling, the man had no trouble in his eyes.

He had never even tested He Ling's identity.

It seemed that he believed whatever she said.

Yin Shenning just felt that there was something unusual about this girl who broke into the Qi Wheel.

The head of the Nanhua Sect has changed three times, and during this period, he has never seen anyone else.

However, Yin Shenning was not afraid of loneliness and did not want to leave her alone to talk and relieve her boredom.

Yin Shen Ning was determined that the girl would return to Qi Zi Lun again.

His eyes lingered on the girl's face and asked: "What's your name?"

He Ling's face did not change: "Xue Miaoshan."

A name that sounds very kind.

The Licking System didn't expect He Ling to be so well prepared. He even thought about his pseudonym in advance and didn't hesitate for a second.

[He Ling, is this your name before time travel?] it inquired.

【snort.] He Ling snorted coldly in her heart, [It's really unpleasant for you to curse.】

Her name is He Ling, and there is no difference whether she is before or after time travel.

Xue Miaoshan is a demon witch from the Yin Yang Sect. She is much more ruthless and ruthless than her. She can do harm to her own people. The dog-licking system actually says that she is Xue Miaoshan. How can she compare to Xue Miaoshan?

The dog-licking system is enlightened.

This Xue Miaoshan should be the enemy of the host.

Putting the blame on one's enemies is in line with the host's personality and qualities.

He Ling climbed out of Wuming Well, patted his clothes, and suddenly heard a dark voice.

"Junior sister, it's so late and you're not sleeping in your room. Why are you going to the bottom of the well?"

Fifth Qi!

Why is he here?

For a moment, He Ling had the idea of ​​killing people and silencing them, but he soon came to his senses.
